groups.name: Chấm in truyền thống và hạt
Hiệu ứng áo thun đang thịnh hành
Vintage: ảnh cũ, in cũ, áo cũ
Màu: 4 màu CMYK và màu spot

styles.name: Round dot
styles.desc: Even grid of round dots. The most popular halftone, with natural tonal transitions.

styles.name: Ellipse
styles.desc: Elongated dots that chain together in midtones. Softer transitions than round dots.

styles.name: Line
styles.desc: Parallel lines that thicken with darkness, with adjustable angle. Great for engraved or vintage looks.

styles.name: Square dot
styles.desc: Square dots, clean and technical.

styles.name: Diamond dot
styles.desc: Diamond-shaped dots that form a checkerboard at 50%.

styles.name: Cross
styles.desc: Repeating plus signs that create a distinctive grid texture.

styles.name: Horizontal stripes
styles.desc: Even horizontal lines that thicken with darkness.

styles.name: Vertical stripes
styles.desc: Even vertical lines that thicken with darkness.

styles.name: Diagonal stripes
styles.desc: 135° diagonal lines that suggest motion.

styles.name: Error diffusion
styles.desc: Floyd–Steinberg error diffusion. Fine grain that keeps detail well.

styles.name: Atkinson
styles.desc: Bright, slightly contrasty grain like early Macs. Very dark areas keep white specks.

styles.name: Stucki
styles.desc: Wide error spread with high detail; more even grain than Floyd–Steinberg.

styles.name: Jarvis
styles.desc: The widest error spread, smooth shading, good for large gradients.

styles.name: Bayer 4×4
styles.desc: 4×4 repeating matrix with chunky retro-game grain.

styles.name: Bayer 8×8
styles.desc: 8×8 repeating matrix, finer than 4×4.

styles.name: Random grain
styles.desc: Randomly scattered grain (FM), with a rough grunge texture.

styles.name: Threshold
styles.desc: Pure black and white, no dots. For logos, text and simple line art.

styles.name: Euclidean dot
styles.desc: The print-industry standard: round in highlights, checkerboard at 50%, round holes in shadows. Holds shadow detail better than round dots.

styles.name: Cell dot
styles.desc: One perfect round dot per cell sized by its average tone, like Filter › Color Halftone. Crisp pop-art dots.

styles.name: Negative dot
styles.desc: Round white holes in solid ink. With white ink on a black shirt, the holes show the shirt color.

styles.name: Fade out
styles.desc: Round dots that fade toward the bottom edge so the image melts into the shirt. Adjust length and direction in Extra effects.

styles.name: Gritty grain
styles.desc: Uneven grains that clump like powdered ink. The Hellstar look. Lower LPI = bigger grain.

styles.name: Photocopy
styles.desc: Harsh black and white with noise and speckles, like a photocopy (Heaven/Hell style). The Threshold slider sets darkness.

styles.name: Grunge
styles.desc: Worn, patchy black and white with pitted edges (Vicinity style). Set the wear in Extra effects.

styles.name: Distressed dots
styles.desc: Round dots that look worn, like an old print.

styles.name: Mezzotint
styles.desc: Short horizontal fibers like a mezzotint engraving.

styles.name: Stipple
styles.desc: Same-size dots that only vary in density, like drawing with a fine pen.

styles.name: Sketch
styles.desc: Pencil outlines plus cross-hatching in dark areas, like a hand sketch.

styles.name: Rounded square
styles.desc: Square dots with rounded corners, softer and more retro.

styles.name: Four-leaf clover
styles.desc: Four-leaf clover dots. Use a low LPI to see the shape.

styles.name: Six-petal flower
styles.desc: Flower-shaped dots, nice for women's and kids' tees.

styles.name: Gear
styles.desc: Gear-shaped dots for mechanical and car themes.

styles.name: Water drop
styles.desc: Drop-shaped dots with a round base and pointed tip.

styles.name: Bullseye
styles.desc: Each dot is a set of nested rings like a target.

styles.name: Square frame
styles.desc: Each dot is a hollow square that thickens with darkness.

styles.name: Random rain
styles.desc: Short dashes rotated randomly in each cell, like rain or straw.

styles.name: Scattered triangles
styles.desc: Randomly rotated triangles for a geometric glitch look.

styles.name: Cells
styles.desc: Round dots placed randomly like cells; no grid, so no repeating pattern.

styles.name: Sunflower
styles.desc: Dots arranged at the 137.5° golden angle like sunflower seeds, radiating from the center.

styles.name: Morse code
styles.desc: Rows of dots and dashes like Morse code; dark areas get longer, thicker dashes.

styles.name: Honeycomb dots
styles.desc: Round dots on a hexagonal grid. Smoother than a square grid, less visible direction.

styles.name: Hexagon
styles.desc: Hexagon-shaped dots that join into a honeycomb in dark areas.

styles.name: Triangle
styles.desc: Triangle-shaped dots for geometric and streetwear designs.

styles.name: Star
styles.desc: Five-point star dots. Use a low LPI (10–25) to see the stars.

styles.name: Heart
styles.desc: Heart-shaped dots. Use a low LPI to see them clearly.

styles.name: Dash
styles.desc: Short dash dots rotated to the angle, like rain streaks.

styles.name: Ring
styles.desc: Each dot is a hollow ring that thickens with darkness.

styles.name: Lattice
styles.desc: Diagonal two-way grid like a lattice fence; lines thicken with darkness.

styles.name: Brick wall
styles.desc: Mortar lines of a brick wall that thicken in dark areas. Street style.

styles.name: Honeycomb lines
styles.desc: Hexagon cell outlines like a honeycomb; lines thicken with darkness.

styles.name: Concentric squares
styles.desc: Concentric square frames. Supports the multi-center layout.

styles.name: Japanese waves
styles.desc: Seigaiha pattern: nested arcs like stylized Japanese waves.

styles.name: Spider web
styles.desc: Rings and spokes woven into a web. Multi-center ready; great for Halloween and rock tees.

styles.name: Basket weave
styles.desc: Alternating horizontal and vertical stripes like woven fabric.

styles.name: Diamond plate
styles.desc: Diagonal ribs like anti-slip steel plate, for industrial and car themes.

styles.name: Zebra
styles.desc: Wavy zebra stripes that thicken with darkness.

styles.name: Leopard
styles.desc: Irregular ring spots like leopard skin.

styles.name: Marble
styles.desc: Thin flowing veins like marble.

styles.name: Camo
styles.desc: Large military blotches; coverage matches the tone exactly.

styles.name: Rings
styles.desc: Concentric circles. Use Multi-center layout for clusters of big and small rings.

styles.name: Spiral
styles.desc: One continuous spiral. Turn on multiple centers for many spirals of different sizes twisting both ways.

styles.name: Sunburst
styles.desc: Rays from the center like sunbeams. Multiple centers give a fireworks or manga look.

styles.name: Circular dots
styles.desc: Round dots arranged in concentric rings around the center.

styles.name: Waves
styles.desc: Parallel wavy lines, banknote-engraving style.

styles.name: Zigzag
styles.desc: Zigzag lines that thicken with darkness.

styles.name: Cross-hatch
styles.desc: One-way hatching in light areas with a second perpendicular layer in dark areas, like pen drawing.

styles.name: Squiggle
styles.desc: Rows of horizontal waves; darker areas have denser, stronger waves.

styles.name: Wood grain
styles.desc: Curving wood grain with natural noise.

styles.name: Fingerprint
styles.desc: Warped concentric rings like a fingerprint.

styles.name: Bulge
styles.desc: Horizontal lines that bulge in the middle for a 3D sphere feel.

styles.name: Twirl
styles.desc: Lines twisting around the center like a whirlpool.

styles.name: Interference
styles.desc: Two offset ring systems overlap into interference patterns.

styles.name: Maze
styles.desc: Arcs joining at random into a maze (Truchet tiles).

styles.name: Fish scales
styles.desc: Staggered arcs like fish or dragon scales.

styles.name: Contour lines
styles.desc: Only draws lines of equal tone, like a topographic map. Great for line art.

styles.name: Sunset stripes
styles.desc: 70s retro stripes cutting the lower half, with gaps widening downward. Keeps the design colors.

styles.name: Directional dot fade
styles.desc: The image dissolves into dots along a direction (90° = downward), regardless of light and dark.

styles.name: Cracked ink
styles.desc: Cracks like a well-worn print; lighter areas crack more. Keeps the design colors.

styles.name: Banknote engraving
styles.desc: Engraved lines that bend with light and shadow, like banknotes and stamps.

styles.name: Stencil
styles.desc: Three-tone graffiti stencil: dark = solid, midtones = hatched, light = empty.

styles.name: 1-bit pixel
styles.desc: Large square pixels on or off by tone, old-school game style.

styles.name: ASCII text
styles.desc: The image is built from characters. Change the character set (or type your brand name) in Effect options.

styles.name: Glitch
styles.desc: RGB channel shift, displaced horizontal bands and scanlines, Y2K / VHS style.

styles.name: 2-color riso
styles.desc: Riso print: two grainy ink colors with slight misregistration. Change the two colors in Effect options.

styles.name: 2-color pop art
styles.desc: Two-color round dots like American comics, with offset angles and misregistration.

styles.name: 8-bit pixel
styles.desc: Square color blocks with few color levels, like 8-bit game graphics.

styles.name: Faded vintage
styles.desc: Faded, warm colors with worn, cracked ink like a tee washed for years.

styles.name: Trippy 70s
styles.desc: Psychedelic wavy distortion with a two-color echo outline.

styles.name: Thermal
styles.desc: Maps the image to a thermal-camera palette: purple, red, orange, yellow.

styles.name: Neon outline
styles.desc: Keeps only the outlines and makes them glow like neon. Great on black shirts.

styles.name: Duotone
styles.desc: Maps the image to two colors (color 1 = shadows, color 2 = highlights), fashion-poster style.

styles.name: Rainbow dots
styles.desc: Round-dot halftone colored by a diagonal rainbow. Strength rotates the colors.

styles.name: RGB LED dots
styles.desc: Three red, green and blue dots per cell like an LED screen. Pops on black shirts.

styles.name: Spray paint
styles.desc: Edges dissolve into paint mist with drips running down, graffiti style.

styles.name: Sepia photo
styles.desc: Turns the image into brown sepia tones like an early 20th-century photo, with light ink wear.

styles.name: Yellowed photo
styles.desc: Paper turned yellow with scattered age spots, like a photo stored for years.

styles.name: Scratched film
styles.desc: Faded colors with vertical scratches and dust, like an old film reel.

styles.name: Washed-out tee
styles.desc: Faded, pale colors with patchy wear, like a shirt washed many times.

styles.name: Old screen print
styles.desc: Reduces to 5 flat colors like a screen print, then adds ink cracks and worn patches.

styles.name: Rubber stamp
styles.desc: One ink color with uneven coverage and rough edges, like a hand stamp. Change the ink color in the Effect options card.

styles.name: 80s band tee
styles.desc: Big one-color halftone dots with large worn patches, like an 80s tour shirt.

styles.name: 70s surf
styles.desc: Brown, orange, yellow and cream gradient of a 70s surf tee.

styles.name: Propaganda poster
styles.desc: Three flat areas: black, an accent color and a cream base, like a lithographed propaganda poster.

styles.name: Woodcut
styles.desc: Dark areas go solid and midtones become flowing carved lines, like a woodcut print.

styles.name: Linocut
styles.desc: Large solid areas with short gouge marks scattered through, like a linocut print.

styles.name: Old newspaper
styles.desc: Coarse one-color halftone with ink that goes heavy and light, like an old printed newspaper.

styles.name: Vintage comic
styles.desc: Big yellow, magenta and cyan dots printed off-register with bold black lines, like a 1950s comic.

styles.name: Faded Polaroid
styles.desc: Low contrast, shadows tinted teal, highlights warm and a dissolving border, like an old Polaroid.

styles.name: Kodachrome
styles.desc: Rich, warm colors with deep reds and film grain, like 1960s color film.

styles.name: Cross-process
styles.desc: Highlights shift yellow-green and shadows shift blue, like film developed in the wrong chemistry.

styles.name: Lomo
styles.desc: Strongly saturated colors with dark corners, like a Lomo camera.

styles.name: Cyanotype
styles.desc: Prussian-blue range of an old sun-printed blueprint.

styles.name: Brown duotone
styles.desc: Three-tone range of dark brown, café au lait and cream with light grain.

styles.name: Misregistered print
styles.desc: Separates 4 flat colors and offsets each plate a little, like an old press running out of register.

styles.name: Matchbox label
styles.desc: Three flat colors on worn, patchy paper, like an old matchbox label.

styles.name: Peeling paint
styles.desc: The print flakes off in patches, like old paint on a wall.

styles.name: Rust
styles.desc: Orange-brown rust patches creep into the image, like an old metal sign.

styles.name: Sun-faded
styles.desc: The top fades more than the bottom, like a shirt left in the sun for a long time.

styles.name: Ink bleed
styles.desc: Dark ink spreads and edges bleed unevenly, like printing on absorbent paper.

styles.name: Letterpress
styles.desc: Flat colors with mottled pressed ink, heavier in some spots and lighter in others, like letterpress printing.

styles.name: 2-color varsity
styles.desc: Dark parts filled with one color plus a thick outline in a second color, lightly cracked, like American college team lettering.

styles.name: Engraved stamp
styles.desc: One-color horizontal engraved lines, like an old postage stamp.

styles.name: VHS tape
styles.desc: Color channels shift, with scan lines and noise bands like a VHS videotape.

styles.name: Thrift tee
styles.desc: Lightly faded with fine cracks and tiny holes, like a shirt from a second-hand market.

styles.name: Color honeycomb
styles.desc: Like the face_40x40 sample: 4 colors (yellow, pink, cyan, black), round dots on a honeycomb grid, each color rotated 15° to avoid moiré. Unprinted areas show the shirt.

styles.name: Color round dots
styles.desc: Offset-style color halftone: 4 colors of round dots at the standard angles C15 M75 Y0 K45.

styles.name: Color lines
styles.desc: Four colors of lines, each at its own angle, weaving a colored mesh.

styles.name: Color grain
styles.desc: Four colors of random grain; no grid, so never any moiré.

styles.name: Spot colors
styles.desc: Finds the main colors and prints each area as a flat color; the shirt color is dropped so the shirt shows through (Iron Muscle style).

styles.name: Grainy spot colors
styles.desc: Spot colors where transitions between colors and into the shirt use gritty grain (Hellstar style).
